maria: Heads-up — docs build failing on latest PR, anchors in pages with inline collapse to empty ids after MDX transform. Build log: https://ci.internal/reports/12345 :disappointed: kevin: ugh. which page? can you paste failing log snippet? maria: repro on docs/guides/deploy.md — snippet from build: ``` WARN: duplicate id '' generated from heading 'Quick start' ``` Seems the inline HTML id removed quotes/characters. ash: is this the mdx plugin that strips attributes? we had similar with raw html sanitization earlier. sam: I think it's the rehype-slug ordering; inline HTML nodes lose attributes if rehype-raw runs after slugify. Try moving rehype-raw before the slug plugin. kevin: can you test with local preview? run `yarn docs:preview --page guides/deploy` and watch logs. maria: repro'd locally. patch idea: wrap inline `` as `
` then postprocess with a tiny script in docs/ci/fix-anchors.js to rewrite to proper anchors during the build. Not ideal but fast. nash: I'd prefer not to hack. Safer short-term fix: add explicit header ids to the headings and remove inline anchor markup on that page. sam: both are fine. For a quick prod fix, add explicit `{#quick-start}` to the headings in deploy.md and open a follow-up ticket to reorder rehype plugins and add a regression test. maria: created PR #4098 with the explicit-ids quick fix and attached failing CI screenshot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4098 docsite-bot: deploy preview created — https://deploy-preview.docs.internal/4098 (checks: accessibility, linkcheck) kevin: LGTM. follow-up: tech-debt issue GH-4100 to adjust mdx pipeline ordering and add an integration test for inline HTML anchors. assigning @ash. nash: on it. I'll draft an RFC and try the plugin reorder in a branch this week, will report back. sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
